He placed the note in the logbook, beside the weather reports, and for weeks he scanned the horizon, imagining a small boat, a waving hand, a woman on a distant shore.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一艘尚未靠岸的船。高架桥空着，路灯把梧桐的影子拉得很长。便利店的白光落在人行道上，一个夜班店员正把新到的牛奶摆上货架。远处有清洁车缓缓驶过，水声贴着地面散开。写字楼只剩零星几扇窗亮着，像失眠者的眼睛。偶尔有出租车穿过十字路口，尾灯在湿漉漉的柏油路上拖出一小段红。天还没有亮，但风里已经有一点清晨的凉意。", "w03": "- Recursion means a job does a smaller version of the same job before it finishes.\n- Think of nested boxes: open one, and inside is a smaller box with the same instructions, until you reach a tiny box with a toy.\n- Always have a stopping rule, or the boxes never end and the job keeps calling itself forever."}
